Taxonomy from the NCBI online, without a local database

Source: R/get_tax_by_taxID.R
get_tax_online.Rd

Look up taxonomy in the NCBI Taxonomy database through the E-utilities (efetch, esearch), over the internet. For when the local database of get_tax() is not there yet, or for a few taxa; get_tax() is much faster for many taxids and works offline once built.

  • get_tax_by_taxID(): taxonomy of taxids (or of the taxids of a BLASTr result, as in get_tax()).

  • get_tax_by_name(): taxids and taxonomy of names, matched first as scientific names, then as any name the NCBI knows (synonyms, common names).

Both return the same columns as get_tax(), so the tables can be used in place of each other. The taxonomy is the current one at the NCBI, which may be newer than the BLAST database.

The NCBI accepts 3 requests per second, or 10 with an API key (see https://support.nlm.nih.gov/kbArticle/?pn=KA-05317): set it in api_key or in the environment variable ENTREZ_KEY or NCBI_API_KEY. Taxids are sent in batches of 200.

Usage

get_tax_by_taxID(
  organisms_taxIDs,
  ranks = tax_ranks_default,
  api_key = NULL,
  ...
)

get_tax_by_name(
  organisms_names,
  ranks = tax_ranks_default,
  api_key = NULL,
  ...
)

parallel_get_tax(organisms_taxIDs, ...)

Arguments

organisms_taxIDs

Taxids (character or numeric), or a BLASTr result.

ranks

Ranks returned as columns, as in get_tax().

api_key

NCBI API key (optional).

...

Ignored (arguments of older versions).

organisms_names

Names of taxa (e.g. "Homo sapiens", "Salminus").

Value

A tibble as in get_tax(): taxid, found, sci_name, rank, one column per rank, lineage, lineage_taxids and merged_into. get_tax_by_name() adds, before them, name (as given) and matched_by ("scientific name", "other name" or NA when not found); a name with more than one taxid (a homonym) gets one row per taxid.

See also

Other taxonomy functions: get_tax(), make_taxonomy_db()

Examples

# \donttest{
# needs internet
if (requireNamespace("curl", quietly = TRUE) && curl::has_internet()) {
  get_tax_by_taxID(c("9606", "10090"))
  get_tax_by_name(c("Homo sapiens", "Salminus brasiliensis"))
}
#> # A tibble: 2 × 21
#>   name     matched_by taxid found sci_name rank  domain kingdom phylum subphylum
#>   <chr>    <chr>      <chr> <lgl> <chr>    <chr> <chr>  <chr>   <chr>  <chr>    
#> 1 Homo sa… scientifi… 9606  TRUE  Homo sa… spec… Eukar… Metazoa Chord… Craniata 
#> 2 Salminu… scientifi… 9302… TRUE  Salminu… spec… Eukar… Metazoa Chord… Craniata 
#> # ℹ 11 more variables: class <chr>, subclass <chr>, order <chr>,
#> #   suborder <chr>, family <chr>, subfamily <chr>, genus <chr>, species <chr>,
#> #   lineage <chr>, lineage_taxids <chr>, merged_into <chr>
# }
